content:
Critics on X hijacked the Trump White House’s Thanksgiving turkey naming contest on Sunday, using the opportunity to mock Donald Trump, his administration and some of his most prominent supporters.

The White House had invited the public to vote on names for the two turkeys set to receive this year’s presidential pardon on the South Lawn, at Trump’s new helipad, on Tuesday.

It offered three choices: “Freedom and Feathers,” “Commander and Chief” and “Honey and Ham.” Voting concluded Sunday afternoon and the winners’ names will be announced Monday.
